title: Who's Who
question: How did the policeman discover that the whole thing was a joke?

meanings.usage: 指故意制造的欺骗他人取乐的虚假事件

meanings.meaning: 气动的；由压缩空气操作的
meanings.usage: 常用来描述靠气体压力工作的工具或设备
指用于钻孔的工具，pneumatic drill即风钻、气动钻机
指故意误导他人的行为或手段
常用搭配indulge in sth，表示放任自己做某事
指受到伤害、欺骗或不利影响的人
常用搭配be grateful to sb for sth，表示因某事感谢某人
用于描述在事件发生前给出的信息、通知等
指带有拱形顶的通道或入口
常用搭配threaten to do sth，表示扬言要做某事
常用搭配remonstrate with sb，表示向某人提出异议或规劝
用来描述动作或情绪的强烈程度
用于描述带有讽刺意味的说话或行为方式
表示正式允许某人做某事，常用被动语态permission was granted
表示和某人一起去某处，常用搭配accompany sb to sp

phrases.usage: 表示专门从事、专攻某一领域或活动

examples.en: The company specializes in organic skincare products.
examples.zh: 这家公司专门生产有机护肤产品。

phrases.usage: 表示装扮成、打扮成特定的样子

examples.en: The little girl dressed up as a princess for the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 小女孩在万圣节派对上装扮成了公主。

examples.en: It took the firefighters three hours to put out the forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员花了三个小时才扑灭这场森林火灾。

phrases.usage: 表示认真对待某人、把某人的话当回事

examples.en: Don't take him seriously - he's always making silly jokes.
examples.zh: 别把他的话当真，他总爱开无聊的玩笑。

phrases.usage: 表示开某人的玩笑、捉弄某人

examples.en: The boys love to play jokes on their classmates on April Fool's Day.
examples.zh: 男孩子们喜欢在愚人节那天捉弄同学。

examples.en: The police were on the scene within five minutes of receiving the emergency call.
examples.zh: 警察接到紧急电话后五分钟内就赶到了现场。

phrases.usage: 表示靠武力、用强制手段

examples.en: The security guards had to remove the troublemaker by force.
examples.zh: 保安不得不强行把闹事者带走。

examples.en: He lost his temper when he found his laptop had been damaged.
examples.zh: 当他发现自己的笔记本电脑被弄坏时，他发了脾气。

examples.en: The suspect was under arrest for stealing cars.
examples.zh: 这名嫌疑人因盗窃车辆被逮捕。

examples.en: I need to make a telephone call to my parents to tell them I'll be home late.
examples.zh: 我得给我父母打个电话，告诉他们我会晚点儿回家。

sentences.en: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 大学学生为什么似乎比其他人更喜欢恶作剧，这一点从未得到解释。

sentences.en: Students specialize in a particular type of practical joke: the hoax.
sentences.zh: 学生们擅长一种特殊类型的恶作剧：骗局。

sentences.en: Inviting the fire brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception which no self-respecting student would ever indulge in.
sentences.zh: 邀请消防队扑灭一场不存在的火灾是一种粗俗的欺骗形式，任何有自尊的学生都不会沉溺其中。

sentences.en: Students often create amusing situations which are funny to everyone except the victims.
sentences.zh: 学生们经常制造一些有趣的场面，除了受害者，每个人都觉得好笑。

sentences.en: When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill outside his university,
sentences.zh: 最近，当一名学生看到两名工人在他大学外面使用一台气动钻时，

sentences.en: he immediately telephoned the police and informed them that two students dressed up as workmen
sentences.zh: 他立即打电话报警，并告知警察有两名打扮成工人的学生

sentences.en: were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill.
sentences.zh: 正在用气动钻挖路。

sentences.en: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away,
sentences.zh: 他一挂掉电话，就走到工人那里，告诉他们如果一个警察命令他们离开，

sentences.en: they were not to take him seriously.
sentences.zh: 他们不必把他当真。

sentences.en: He added that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，有个学生打扮成警察，正在对人们开各种愚蠢的玩笑。

sentences.en: Both the police and the workmen were grateful to the student for this piece of advance information.
sentences.zh: 警察和工人都很感谢这名学生提供的这条提前消息。

sentences.en: The student hid in an archway nearby where he could watch and hear everything that went on.
sentences.zh: 这名学生藏在附近的一个拱门里，在那里他能看到和听到发生的一切。

sentences.en: Sure enough, a policeman arrived on the scene and politely asked the workmen to go away.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，一名警察来到了现场，并礼貌地要求工人离开。

sentences.en: When he received a very rude reply from one of the workmen, he threatened to remove them by force.
sentences.zh: 当他从其中一名工人那里得到非常粗鲁的答复时，他威胁要强行把他们带走。

sentences.en: The workmen told him to do as he pleased and the policeman telephoned for help.
sentences.zh: 工人们告诉他想怎样就怎样，于是警察打电话请求支援。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, 4 more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，又有4名警察赶到，并与工人们进行交涉。

sentences.en: As the men refused to stop working, the police attempted to seize the pneumatic drill.
sentences.zh: 由于工人们拒绝停止工作，警察试图没收气动钻。

sentences.en: The workmen struggled fiercely and one of them lost his temper.
sentences.zh: 工人们激烈反抗，其中一人发了脾气。

sentences.en: He threatened to call the police.
sentences.zh: 他威胁要报警。

sentences.en: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
sentences.zh: 听罢此言，警察讽刺地指出，这几乎没有必要，因为这些人已经被逮捕了。

sentences.en: Pretending to speak seriously, one of the workmen asked if he might make a telephone call before being taken to the station.
sentences.zh: 其中一名工人假装认真地问道，在被带到警察局之前，他是否可以打个电话。

sentences.en: Permission was granted and a policeman accompanied him to a pay phone.
sentences.zh: 许可被准予，一名警察陪他去了公用电话亭。

sentences.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
sentences.zh: 只有当他看到那个人实际上是在打电话给警察时，他才意识到他们都成了骗局的受害者。

exercises.prompt: “威胁；恐吓” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: threaten · /ˈθretn/ · verb · 威胁；恐吓。常用搭配threaten to do sth，表示扬言要做某事

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：骗局；恶作剧
exercises.explain: hoax · /həʊks/ · noun · 骗局；恶作剧。指故意制造的欺骗他人取乐的虚假事件

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：I need to _____ to my parents to tell them I'll be home late.
exercises.hint: 我得给我父母打个电话，告诉他们我会晚点儿回家。
exercises.explain: make a telephone call：表示打电话（我得给我父母打个电话，告诉他们我会晚点儿回家。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a _____ ordered them to go away,
exercises.hint: 他一挂掉电话，就走到工人那里，告诉他们如果一个警察命令他们离开，
exercises.explain: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, — 他一挂掉电话，就走到工人那里，告诉他们如果一个警察命令他们离开，

source.en: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away,

exercises.prompt: “当"only+状语（从句）"位于句首时，句子需要使用部分倒装结构，即将助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前，强调该状语的条件性” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: Only + 状语/状语从句 + 助动词/情态动词/be动词 + 主语 + 谓语剩余部分
options: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词 (Modal + Perfect Infinitive)
exercises.explain: only引导的部分倒装句：Only + 状语/状语从句 + 助动词/情态动词/be动词 + 主语 + 谓语剩余部分：用于强调只有在某个条件下才会发生某事，突出条件的重要性

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Shortly afterwards, 4 more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen.
options: 但它们的许多功能已被小型、强大的个人电脑（通常称为PC）所取代。
不久之后，又有4名警察赶到，并与工人们进行交涉。
这使得跟在她后面的司机猛踩刹车。
尽管这位贵族在每次表演中都应该读这封信，但他总是坚持信应该写得清清楚楚。
exercises.explain: Shortly afterwards, 4 more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen. — 不久之后，又有4名警察赶到，并与工人们进行交涉。

source.en: Shortly afterwards, 4 more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen.

grammar.title: only引导的部分倒装句
grammar.definition: 当"only+状语（从句）"位于句首时，句子需要使用部分倒装结构，即将助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前，强调该状语的条件性
grammar.structure: Only + 状语/状语从句 + 助动词/情态动词/be动词 + 主语 + 谓语剩余部分
grammar.usage: 用于强调只有在某个条件下才会发生某事，突出条件的重要性

examples.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
examples.zh: 当他看到那个人真的在给警察打电话时，他才意识到他们所有人都成了一场恶作剧的受害者。

examples.en: Only by practicing every day can you improve your spoken English quickly.
examples.zh: 只有每天练习，你才能快速提高英语口语。

patterns.pattern: It has never been explained why...

original.en: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than anyone else.
original.zh: 为什么大学生似乎比其他人更喜欢搞恶作剧，这一点一直没有得到解释。

examples.en: It has never been explained why this ancient custom disappeared suddenly hundreds of years ago.
examples.zh: 为什么这个古老的习俗在几百年前突然消失，一直没有得到解释。

examples.en: It has never been explained why he quit his well-paid job without telling anyone.
examples.zh: 为什么他没告诉任何人就辞掉了高薪工作，这一点没人说得清。

patterns.pattern: As soon as sb had done sth, sb did sth else

original.en: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously.
original.zh: 他一挂电话，就走到工人那里，告诉他们如果有警察命令他们离开，不要把他当回事。

examples.en: As soon as she had finished her homework, she went to the park to walk her dog.
examples.zh: 她一做完作业，就去公园遛狗了。

examples.en: As soon as the guests had left, he started to clean up the messy living room.
examples.zh: 客人一走，他就开始打扫乱糟糟的客厅。

original.en: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
original.zh: 听到这话，警察讽刺地指出，这几乎没有必要，因为这两个人已经被逮捕了。

examples.en: At this, the little girl burst into tears and ran to her mother.
examples.zh: 听到这话，小女孩突然哭了起来，跑向她的妈妈。

examples.en: At this, the manager smiled and nodded to show his agreement with the proposal.
examples.zh: 听到这里，经理笑了笑，点头表示他同意这个提议。
